title: Dahl v. HEM Pharmaceuticals — timing of an inducement
shortTitle: Dahl v. HEM Pharmaceuticals — timing of an inducement
summary: The notes ask how the timing of research participation and a promised benefit affects consideration.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

Identify which participation or continued conduct was sought in exchange and whether it occurred before or after the promise. Avoid treating every benefit from research as consideration for any later assurance.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 60–61. Open assigned page 60.
